title: The Beginners — Classes 11–12 Teacher Survey

approval.basis: DEC-03: respondent wording drafted by Claude from the approved question-focus register and adopted under the project owner's delegated authority (2026-11-22). Must be cognitively pretested with 3–5 teachers before full fieldwork. V1.1: district label changed after DEC-21 (all schools eligible, including Shillong), 2026-11-22.

notes: Question IDs, variable names, response types and option order/meaning from source; wording drafted.

What type of management does your school have?

change_log.detail: Source "12 Meghalaya districts; East Khasi Hills excluding Shillong city" enumerated as the 12 districts in the STU_11_12 order; East Khasi Hills labelled "(outside Shillong city)"; no "Other" (eligibility is controlled by the school master list).
Option "Multiple" removed: the question is multiple choice, so teaching several streams is recorded by selecting each.
Options kept verbatim from source (already full labels).
Reference specified as "students you teach in your main subject" (resolves ISS-023). "N/A where needed" → "Not applicable".
"Fortnightly" → "Every two weeks" (plainer for all readers; same meaning).
All other options: abbreviations expanded only; order and meaning unchanged.
"East Khasi Hills (outside Shillong city)" → "East Khasi Hills" (code 1 unchanged). Shillong schools are now eligible (DEC-21).
